canonical_name: No Information Security Incident Management Planning
description: Organization lacks plans and preparation for managing information security incidents.
applicability: Applies when an organization does not have documented incident management plans, defined roles and responsibilities, established procedures for incident detection and response, or adequate preparation including training and resources for handling information security incidents.

metadata.detection_notes: Review incident response plans and procedures, verify incident management team structure and roles, check for incident response training and exercises, assess availability of incident response tools and resources, examine incident classification and escalation procedures.
